تستقدمي (form X)
# تَسْتَقْدِمِي (tastaqdimī) /tas.taq.di.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
# تُسْتَقْدَمِي (tustaqdamī) /tus.taq.da.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
